# Mateusz Dąbrowski

> Documentation, code snippets and configuration guides for Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next, Marketing Cloud Engagement (SQL, SSJS, AMPScript) and Marketing Cloud Personalization. Written by Mateusz Dąbrowski, a European Salesforce MVP and Marketing Cloud Architect.

Each link below points to a markdown copy of the page. The HTML page has the same path with a trailing slash in place of ".md". All docs in one file: https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/llms-full.txt

The content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. When you quote or summarise a page, credit it as "Article Title" - Mateusz Dąbrowski (https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/) - CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and link the HTML page. Licence details: https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/sites/licence/

## Salesforce > Marketing Cloud Engagement > SQL

- [MCE SQL Basics](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-basics.md): SELECT your data FROM Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement WHERE drag-and-drop Filters are not enough.
- [MCE SQL Select](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-select.md): Selected information on the SELECT statement in Marketing Cloud Engagement SQL.
- [MCE SQL From](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-from.md): Tell the SQL query FROM where you need the data.
- [MCE SQL Join](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-join.md): Data Extensions. System Data Views. With the JOIN statement, use one query to rule them all.
- [Marketing Cloud Engagement SQL Where](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-where.md): Use WHERE to make your query lean and to the point. Less is more.
- [MCE SQL Case](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-case.md): Empower your Marketing Cloud Engagement queries with conditional SQL CASE logic.
- [MCE SQL Like](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-like.md): Get a LIKE and build more flexible Marketing Cloud Engagement SQL queries.
- [Marketing Cloud Engagement SQL String Functions](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-string-functions.md): Take control over strings with built-in SQL functions. Let the query do the job.
- [MCE SQL Date Functions](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-date-functions.md): Take control over dates with built-in SQL functions. Let the query do the job.
- [Marketing Cloud Engagement SQL Numeric Functions](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-numeric-functions.md): Take control over numbers with built-in SQL functions. Let the query do the job.
- [MCE SQL Conversion Functions](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-conversion-functions.md): Break from the limits of Data Extension data types. Use full power of SQL to control your values.
- [MCE SQL Aggregate Functions](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-aggregate-functions.md): Group rows and apply aggregate functions to see the big picture in your data extensions.
- [MCE SQL NULL Functions](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-null-functions.md): IS NULL, or IS NOT NULL, that is the question. Ways of working with NULL values in Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE) SQL.
- [MCE SQL Style Guide](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/docs/salesforce/marketing-cloud-engagement/sql/sql-style-guide.md): Query with style. Readable, bug-free code is a few shifts & spaces away.

## Apps

- [Diagramforce](https://diagramforce.com): Free browser-based diagramming tool for Salesforce architects: architecture diagrams, data models, process flows and org charts with Salesforce icons.
- [Strum file format for LLMs](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/strum/llm-spec.md): Specification an LLM can follow to transcribe a song into a .strum file the Strum app imports.
- [Shelf - Your Digital Pocket](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/shelf/): The small things you keep needing - codes, addresses, IBANs, snippets - encrypted on your device and one tap from your clipboard on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
- [Slot - Your Inboxes in One App](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/slot/): Every Google and Microsoft account in one native Mac app, each with completely isolated data. Mail, Calendar, Drive, Meet, Outlook, Teams and more.
- [Strum - Tabs Made Easy](https://mateuszdabrowski.pl/strum/): Tablature, chord and strum-pattern editor for ukulele and guitar - for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
